sources.title: Higher-Curvature Gravity, Black Holes and Holography

evidence.text: Which higher-curvature gravities have tractable linearized spectra and black holes, how do their corrections affect four-dimensional black-hole thermodynamics, and what CFT information can their AdS solutions reveal?

sources.title: Derivative corrections to extremal black holes with moduli

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative operators change the fixed-charge mass, entropy and long-range self-force of large extremal black holes with moduli, and are the three corrections correlated in ways relevant to the WGC and RFC?

sources.title: Universality on the thermodynamic relation with corrections in higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: Does the Goon–Penco entropy–extremality response relation extend to higher-dimensional de Sitter black holes, to approaches along either horizon toward both mass endpoints, and to ensembles allowing charge and angular momentum to shift with the perturbation?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: What are the leading α′ corrections to d-dimensional black holes carrying fundamental-string momentum and winding charges, and how do those corrections affect gravitational thermodynamics, entropy and mass/charge relations?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Viscosity Bound with Six-Derivative Corrections

evidence.text: Can leading and next-to-leading higher-derivative corrections make the downward extremal mass-to-charge correction associated with the WGC compatible with the KSS viscosity bound for charged AdS5 black branes?

sources.title: Effective holographic theories of momentum relaxation and violation of conductivity bound

evidence.text: How do symmetry-allowed higher-derivative couplings between charge and homogeneous translation-breaking sectors affect charged black branes and DC transport? Can they invalidate the positive conductivity lower bound of simpler Einstein–Maxwell–scalar models while respecting the constraints examined here?

sources.title: Entropy Bounds on Effective Field Theory from Rotating Dyonic Black Holes

evidence.text: What field-basis invariant constraints on four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell EFT follow from positive classical Wald-entropy corrections for thermodynamically stable rotating dyonic black holes, and how do these constraints affect extremality and black-hole decay?

sources.title: De-singularizing the extremal GMGHS black hole via higher derivatives corrections

evidence.text: Can the fully nonlinear equations of an action truncated to O(α′) corrections resolve the singular extremal GMGHS horizon and admit regular, asymptotically flat bulk black holes?

sources.title: α′-corrections to near extremal dyonic strings and weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative corrections to near-extremal forces provide a WGC-motivated consistency criterion when supersymmetry protects the extremal mass-to-charge ratio? How does the answer depend on the thermodynamic quantities held fixed?

sources.title: Repulsive black holes and higher-derivatives

evidence.text: How do four-derivative corrections change the long-range static force between extremal black holes with massless scalars, and when do superextremality and self-repulsion impose different conditions?

sources.title: Corrections to extremal black holes from Iyer-Wald formalism

evidence.text: How do arbitrary perturbations change four-dimensional Kerr-Newman extremality and entropy, and when can energy conditions constrain the sign of those changes without solving the corrected metric?

sources.title: The correlation of WGC and hydrodynamics bound with R4 correction in the charged AdS<math altimg="si1.svg"><msub><mrow/><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo linebreak="badbreak" linebreakstyle="after">+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> black brane

evidence.text: Do higher-curvature corrections produce compatible constraints from the weak gravity conjecture and the KSS viscosity bound for a hyperscaling-violating charged black brane, and can their overlap diagnose candidate UV-completable effective theories?

sources.title: Slowly rotating and accelerating <math display="inline"><msup><mi>α</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math>-corrected black holes in four and higher dimensions

evidence.text: Can field redefinitions make the first string-curvature corrections analytically tractable for regular dilatonic black holes, including static solutions in arbitrary dimension and slowly rotating or accelerating solutions in four dimensions?

sources.title: Extremal Kerr Black Holes as Amplifiers of New Physics

evidence.text: Can small higher-curvature corrections produce large physical effects at extremal or near-extremal black-hole horizons despite small ambient curvature?

sources.title: Force-free higher derivative Einstein-Maxwell theory and multi-centered black holes

evidence.text: Which four-derivative Einstein–Maxwell interactions admit static multicentered extremal black holes with position-independent energy, and are their force-free constraints stronger than preservation of the extremal mass–charge ratio?

sources.title: Black hole singularity resolution in <math display="inline"><mi>D</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> via duality-invariant <math display="inline"><msup><mi>α</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></math> corrections

evidence.text: Can classical, duality-invariant corrections to all orders in α′ resolve the two-dimensional black-hole singularity while retaining a regular event horizon, and which choices of corrections admit such geometries?

sources.title: Causality and quasi-normal modes in the GREFT

evidence.text: How do existing causality constraints restrict GREFT black-hole quasi-normal modes, and what additional coefficient bounds follow from conjecturing that EFT corrections cannot resolvably increase their decay lifetimes?

sources.title: EFT corrections to charged black hole quasinormal modes

evidence.text: How do higher-derivative Einstein–Maxwell EFT corrections change charged black-hole quasinormal frequencies, especially near extremality, and do calculable electron-induced corrections satisfy the proposed QNM causality bound?

sources.title: Scalar quasinormal modes in Reissner-Nordström black holes: implications for Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How do four-derivative Einstein–Maxwell EFT operators shift massless scalar zero-damping modes of nearly extremal Reissner–Nordström black holes, and does an adopted QNM causality criterion select the same Wilson-coefficient combination as the black-hole Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: Effective geometrodynamics for renormalization-group improved black-hole spacetimes in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Can RG-improved Schwarzschild geometries be embedded in covariant variational theories with second-order spherical field equations, and how do improvements performed on solutions, equations and actions differ?

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Do higher-derivative effects lower the extremal mass at fixed gauge charge and produce repulsion? These are separate tests when additional massless fields contribute attractive forces, so the dynamical-dilaton example requires both mass and scalar-charge corrections.

sources.title: Higher order correction to the GHS string black hole

evidence.text: What is the leading α′ correction to the extremal magnetic GHS black hole's mass-charge relation, and how can it be extracted despite field-redefinition ambiguity in the higher-derivative effective action?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: Evaluate the Euclidean on-shell action through radial total derivatives, obtain entropy through the Gibbs–Duhem relation, and compare with Wald’s horizon Noether-charge formula.

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: Solution generation uses lifting to a uniform black string, two boosts and T-duality, followed by KK reduction. At order α′, the authors use corrected T-duality rules in a Gauss-Bonnet scheme related to the string scheme by field redefinitions.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Shear viscosity is obtained from the low-frequency radial canonical momentum of a transverse metric fluctuation; entropy density uses Wald's formula. The appendix evaluates the resulting horizon expressions using the zeroth-order solution.

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Viscosity Bound with Six-Derivative Corrections

evidence.text: Covariant Abbott-Deser-Tekin energy: linearize gravitational equations about vacuum AdS, construct a conserved current using a background timelike Killing vector, and express its charge as an asymptotic surface integral. Background AdS has zero energy by construction.

sources.title: Effective holographic theories of momentum relaxation and violation of conductivity bound

evidence.text: The authors solve the radial background equations analytically, choosing C(r)=r² and B=D⁻¹. Homogeneous vector perturbations of the gauge field, metric and scalars determine transport; the Donos–Gauntlett horizon-data method gives DC conductivity.

sources.title: Entropy Bounds on Effective Field Theory from Rotating Dyonic Black Holes

evidence.text: For the nonrotating case, perturbatively solve the Einstein-Maxwell equations with a spherical metric ansatz, then insert the corrected metric into the Wald formula. The authors report agreement with the action method and agreement between surface gravity and the temperature obtained by differentiating entropy.

sources.title: String Axiverse

evidence.text: Conditional on a string QCD axion solving strong CP naturally, should many additional ultralight axions exist, and how could cosmological observations and rotating black holes reveal their masses and couplings?

sources.title: Axion-gauge coupling quantization with a twist

evidence.text: How does the global Standard Model gauge group correlate the quantized axion-photon and axion-gluon couplings, and what experimental target follows when both the gauge group and gluon coupling are minimal?

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: How strongly do CMB power spectra, bispectra and μ-distortion constrain gauge production through an axion–gauge coupling, and can Higgs-generated gauge masses provide an additional local non-Gaussian signal?

sources.title: Limits on a CP-violating scalar axion-nucleon interaction

evidence.text: Do separate scalar-force and stellar-cooling bounds constrain scalar–pseudoscalar coupling products more strongly than direct monopole–dipole searches, and what sensitivity do they imply for CP-violating QCD-axion interactions?

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Can scalar-free strong dynamics unify the Higgs and QCD axion as composite pseudo-Nambu–Goldstone bosons at Λ ∼ 10^11 GeV, while accommodating fermion masses, a small high-scale Higgs quartic and potentially gauge-coupling unification?

sources.title: Axionic Dark Radiation and the Milky Way's Magnetic Field

evidence.text: Could relativistic axionic dark radiation convert in the Milky Way magnetic field strongly enough to explain ROSAT soft X-ray backgrounds or emission above and below the Galactic centre, and which axion parameters would overproduce those signals?

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Can conversion of a primordial cosmic axion background in Coma's magnetic field reproduce both the luminosity and radial morphology of its soft X-ray excess, and what conditional restrictions follow for the axions and their production?

sources.title: ALP Conversion and the Soft X-ray Excess in the Outskirts of the Coma Cluster

evidence.text: Can conversion of a homogeneous cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and radial morphology of Coma's outskirts soft X-ray excess with parameters compatible with the earlier central-region analysis?

sources.title: A Cosmic ALP Background and the Cluster Soft X-ray Excess in A665, A2199 and A2255

evidence.text: Can a cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and morphology of the soft X-ray excesses in A2199 and A2255 while remaining compatible with the absence of an observed excess in A665?

sources.title: Cosmic axion background propagation in galaxies

evidence.text: Can a diffuse cosmic ALP background produce observable photons through conversion in the Milky Way or starburst galaxies, and how do magnetic structure, plasma clumping, and photoelectric absorption determine the signal?

sources.title: Challenges for the Nelson-Barr Mechanism

evidence.text: Under what ultraviolet, symmetry and supersymmetry-breaking conditions can spontaneous CP violation implement Nelson–Barr strong-CP protection naturally, while retaining a large CKM phase and suppressing higher-dimension and radiative corrections?

sources.title: Strong CP and SUZ$_{2}$

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry stabilize the symmetry-breaking scales introduced by Z2 solutions to strong CP while preserving their protection of the QCD vacuum angle?

sources.title: Protecting the Axion with Local Baryon Number

evidence.text: Can gauged baryon number protect an accidental PQ symmetry from dangerous Planck-suppressed operators while its anomaly-canceling exotic fermions implement the KSVZ hidden-axion mechanism?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Does a gravitationally generated axion harmonic preserve the QCD axion's cancellation of strong CP? The reviewed model compares a QCD cosine minimized at zero with a second cosine of the same period and a generic relative phase.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Which observations could probe the light axions discussed here? The source highlights substructure, superradiance, and direct-detection experiments as prospective channels sensitive to axion mass and decay constant.

sources.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

evidence.text: Can the axion endpoint prescription be derived beyond specific string constructions, and does it survive explicit nonperturbative shift breaking? Can running theta be constrained in QCD-like theories or supply useful vacuum branches in self-tuning models?

sources.title: Gauge and gravitational instantons: From 3-forms and fermions to Weak Gravity and flat axion potentials

evidence.text: When can fundamental Dirac matter be omitted from an instanton EFT below the Higgs scale v? Heavy fermions decouple with corrections in v/m; light fermions alter both instanton running and the effective interactions that must remain in the theory.

sources.title: Gravity, Superselection Rules and Axions

evidence.text: Can coupling to quantum gravity turn a superselection parameter into a local field's vacuum expectation value? The proposed example is the QCD θ parameter and its promotion to an axion.

sources.title: A Holographic Perspective on the Axion Quality Problem

evidence.text: Can a holographic composite axion retain its QCD coupling while sufficiently suppressing gravitational PQ violation through separation between an IR-localized axion and UV sources of explicit breaking?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: What QCD vacuum structure is calculable with light composite fields? Leading-order chiral dynamics describes N light flavors while masses and θ vary, subject to confinement and the stated spontaneous chiral-symmetry-breaking pattern.

sources.title: Axions, higher-groups, and emergent symmetry

evidence.text: How does higher-group mixing constrain the relative emergence scales of axion-string charge conservation, Wilson-line screening, axion shifts, magnetic symmetry, and flavor quotients in RG flows realizing axion gauge theories?

sources.title: Cosmic axion background

evidence.text: Can relativistic axions constitute a detectable cosmic axion background (CaB), with source-dependent spectra accessible by repurposing instruments and data designed for nonrelativistic axion dark matter?

sources.title: Goldstone Boson Decays and Chiral Anomalies

evidence.text: How are axion decays into two gauge bosons related to the anomalous divergence of a spontaneously broken global axial current in vector-like and chiral Abelian gauge theories, and what subtleties enter the chiral Ward-identity calculation?

sources.title: Precision axion physics with running axion couplings

evidence.text: Can precision measurements of photon, nucleon and electron couplings distinguish light string-theoretic axions from KSVZ-like and DFSZ-like axions after RG evolution, including a possible supersymmetric extension below the axion decay constant?

sources.title: Peccei-Quinn symmetry with residual symmetries

evidence.text: Can a PQ symmetry with residual discrete subgroups produce an invisible axion from low, potentially TeV-scale scalar VEVs, suppressing its fermion couplings while avoiding the Higgs-portal tuning associated with a very high symmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: Axion from pseudo Goldstone seesaw without Peccei-Quinn symmetry

evidence.text: The historical manuscript asks whether tiny mixing between heavy and ultralight pseudo-Goldstone bosons could produce an axion without an anomalous Peccei–Quinn global symmetry, while keeping symmetry-breaking scales near TeV.

sources.title: Higher-group structure in 2n-dimensional axion-electrodynamics

evidence.text: What higher-group structure is encoded by axion electrodynamics in 2n dimensions, how does it appear in background gauge transformations and anomalies, and what additional operations arise in six dimensions?

sources.title: Modular invariance and the QCD angle

evidence.text: Can spontaneously broken CP and modular invariance explain a large CKM phase while keeping the physical QCD angle zero, reproduce fermion flavour data, and remain viable after heavy thresholds, supergravity, and supersymmetry-breaking corrections?

sources.title: Exploring CP violation beyond the Standard Model and the PQ quality with electric dipole moments

evidence.text: Can nucleon, nuclear and atomic EDM patterns distinguish light-quark or gluon CEDMs from the QCD θ-term, with and without the PQ mechanism, and identify whether the axion vacuum value originates from CEDMs or additional UV PQ breaking?

sources.title: Non-standard axion electrodynamics and the dual Witten effect

evidence.text: Can electromagnetic duality consistently produce non-standard axion-photon couplings, including inverse-electric-coupling enhancement and effective magnetic currents, while retaining a light axion and Standard Model phenomenology?

sources.title: String Axiverse

evidence.text: Separates the massive scalar equation on Kerr into angular and radial problems, recasts the latter as a frequency-dependent Schrödinger problem, and illustrates growth with a barrier toy model. Simplified occupation-number equations model gravitational-wave transitions and accretion.

sources.title: Observational Constraints on Gauge Field Production in Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Sourced scalar perturbations are treated with Green functions. The imported inverse-decay spectrum is Δ_R² = Δ_R,sr²[1 + Δ_R,sr² f₂(ξ)e^(4πξ)], with f₂ evaluated numerically. The massive extension uses a separate-universe δN estimate for conversion of Higgs fluctuations.

sources.title: Limits on a CP-violating scalar axion-nucleon interaction

evidence.text: For QCD axions, use the approximate relations g_sN∼Θ_eff f_π/f_a∼Θ_eff m_a/m_π, g_pe=C_em_e/f_a, and g_pN=C_Nm_N/f_a to express force limits as bounds on Θ_eff, C_eΘ_eff, and C_NΘ_eff.

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Coset NGB matrices and Yukawa spurions organize gauge and four-fermion contributions to the potential. The appendix estimates leading quark-loop potentials and expands them to identify Higgs and σHuHd interactions.

sources.title: Axionic Dark Radiation and the Milky Way's Magnetic Field

evidence.text: Numerically evolve a damped density matrix from a pure axion state along 30 kpc trajectories ending at the Solar System, 8.5 kpc from the Galactic centre. Photon attenuation uses gas distributions and an energy-dependent absorption cross section per hydrogen atom.

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Generate a random vector potential with Rayleigh-distributed amplitudes, uniform phases, and power proportional to k^-n; take its Fourier-space curl and transform to a Gaussian tangled magnetic field. Apply infrared/ultraviolet cutoffs and a radial density-dependent modulation.

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: If ordinary QCD axions are disfavored, can spontaneous breaking of an exact CP symmetry solve strong CP in a quantum-gravity completion? The paper nominates existing models for further embedding studies.

sources.title: Accidental Peccei-Quinn symmetry from gauged U(1) and a high quality axion

evidence.text: Can an anomaly-free gauged axial U(1)a generate accidental Peccei–Quinn symmetry while suppressing gravity-induced PQ violation sufficiently to preserve the strong-CP solution and viable axion dark matter?

evidence.text: Can nonsingular primordial black holes avoid conventional low-mass evaporation exclusions by cooling to slowly radiating states or remnants, thereby supplying dark matter?

sources.title: On the (im)possibility of electrically charged Planck relics

evidence.text: Can compact remnants retain ordinary SM electric charge over cosmological times, accounting for ambient capture, vacuum pair creation, mass dependence, and possible dark-sector or near-extremal exceptions?

sources.title: A Universal Kaluza-Klein Graviton Cascade Rate

evidence.text: Does the KK-graviton three-point amplitude near threshold scale with the parent mass or daughter momentum, how general is the resulting cascade suppression, and what does it imply for cascading graviton dark matter?

sources.title: Nonsingular black holes as dark matter

evidence.text: Uses the two-dimensional trace anomaly T^μ_μ = R/(24π), with R = −n″, and stress-tensor conservation. Integration constants are selected using the stated Unruh conditions: no ingoing flux at infinity and vanishing T_uu at the past horizon.

sources.title: On the (im)possibility of electrically charged Planck relics

evidence.text: The leading local Schwinger kernel is integrated radially outside rh, producing an erfc discharge law and strong-field/near-threshold asymptotics. Separately, cosmic exposure Ech=∫dt nch/v³ converts time-dependent capture into a global no-capture inequality.

sources.title: A Universal Kaluza-Klein Graviton Cascade Rate

evidence.text: Uses Gauss–Codazzi decomposition, background Einstein equations, Israel junction conditions and GHY boundary cancellations to obtain the graviton action. A Weyl transformation maps non-minimal scalar couplings to Einstein frame and absorbs their background effect into the warp factor.

sources.title: Near Threshold Kaluza-Klein Graviton Decays and the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: Bound cascade overlaps using profile completeness, then sum daughter channels. For cosmology, sum decay photons over the freeze-in tower, include survival and redshift, and compare bin-integrated signals with archival Galactic and isotropic gamma-ray spectra.

sources.title: Nonsingular black holes as dark matter

evidence.text: Integrates an inherited primordial-black-hole mass spectrum to estimate abundance. The appendix obtains effective matter density and pressures from the Einstein tensor of the regular four-dimensional metrics and evaluates energy-condition inequalities.

sources.title: Nonsingular black holes as dark matter

evidence.text: Relates temperature and radiation flux to surface gravity. Since an exact analytic horizon location and evaporation-time integral are unavailable, a second-order small-r expansion of n(r) is used to estimate a possible remnant as the horizon radius tends to zero.

sources.title: Primordial Extremal Black Holes as Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can primordial black holes below the ordinary evaporation-survival mass constitute dark matter through dark-charge near-extremality, and can their mergers produce observable Hawking-radiation transients or constrain a dark-sector weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Challenging the Stability of Light Millicharged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can electrically neutral, very light charged scalar dark matter remain cosmologically stable when its large occupation numbers enhance particle–antiparticle annihilation into gauge bosons? The paper examines direct electromagnetic coupling and coupling through kinetic mixing with a massless hidden photon.
